  "schema": "ttqs-one-0141-r07-c1-semantic-review-v1",
  "doc_id": "0141",
  "requirement_id": "I19-E31",
  "candidate_docx_sha256": "0922f737c19598b4448b60f25a6c39391bb444a1dde2536f8eef4e83cf44673a",

  "verdict": "PARTIAL",
  "major_findings": [],
  "minor_findings": [
    {
      "id": "R07-C1-m01",
      "severity": "MINOR",
      "body_locator": "報告基本資訊 表「報告版本與合成事實識別碼」＝「正文修訂 R07」；封面「版本界線」段起句「R07 僅針對 R06 exact-SHA 獨立語意審查列出的四項 minor 作有限修訂…」及同段末「R07 仍待本版 exact-SHA 驗收，不構成正式接受」；對照 附錄五-2 版本修訂歷史最新一列「R07-C1-SYN … 將 UNKNOWN-sourced ASCII 註記明確連結至抱怨條件；將替換流程…統一為五步；將 Q2 Top-2 標示為…；撤除舊版分析下限」",
      "evidence": "The bytes under review implement the R07-C1 repairs (M01–M04 all present), and the revision-history row correctly names the current candidate R07-C1-SYN. However the two most reader-visible version fields — the basic-information table's version field and the cover version-boundary paragraph — still identify the document only as 「R07」 and describe only the R06→R07 change scope. They do not state that this candidate additionally repairs the R07 findings, nor that its version identifier is R07-C1. A reader relying on the cover alone therefore cannot establish which candidate revision the cited SHA belongs to, while the sidecar receipt (work_id TTQS_ONE_0141_I19-E31_R07_C1_SOURCE_MATH_QA) and the revision-history row say R07-C1. This is a document-control/traceability inconsistency only; it does not affect requirement fit, arithmetic, SAMPLE/REAL boundaries, or any claim.",
      "required_action": "Change the basic-information version field and the cover version-boundary sentence to identify the current candidate as R07-C1 (or explicitly state that R07-C1 is the current sub-revision of the R07 body line) and add one short clause recording the C1 repair scope (ASCII complaint-condition provenance, five-step replacement flow, strict >75.00% formula-sheet threshold, removal of legacy analysis floors). No content rebuild is required."
    }
  ],
  "checks": [
    {
      "id": "C01_identity_and_official_mapping",
      "result": "PASS",
      "locator": "報告基本資訊 表（文件編號／官方指標與要求編號／157 方框清單索引／官方佐證資料定位／官方第 9 頁 4 分標註／文件名稱來源／印刷版核選序號）；§貳-一",
      "evidence": "0141, I19-E31 and 157 index 155 are kept as three distinct identifiers; printed checkbox serial is 「UNKNOWN」; the page-9 「4 分」 is explicitly described as one of the 1–5 scoring tiers with no weight column shown, and neither a weight nor an association score is inferred (Official score NOT_ASSIGNED). The document title is correctly attributed to the 129→142 crosswalk, not to the official page 9."
    },
    {
      "id": "C02_genre_blueprint_and_title_blind_usability",
      "result": "PASS",
      "locator": "Whole body; §壹–§拾壹 and 附錄一–五",
      "evidence": "Title-blind, the text is a three-period customer-satisfaction survey and analysis report: comparability and sampling protocol (§參), administration SOP and cleaning rules (§肆), full instrument with anchors and N/A rule (§伍), period counts, item means, Q7 Top-2 and a shared-axis trend figure (§陸), interpretation and inference limits (§柒), two SAMPLE proposals with owner role, check window, success measure and NOT_ADOPTED/NOT_EXECUTED status (§捌), 13 gate/hold rules (§玖), replacement and audit trail (§拾), plus blank form, filled sample, 36 records, dictionary/formula sheet, register template and revision history (附錄一–五). Blueprint D1–D10 are substantially covered; it is not a scoring table, system-uptake report, licensing/employment report or revenue report."
    },
    {
      "id": "C03_questionnaire_and_Q1_Q6_vs_Q7",
      "result": "PASS",
      "locator": "§伍 首段；§參-三 可比性表；§伍-二 題項表；附錄一 空白表；附錄二 範例表；附錄四 題項標籤對照表",
      "evidence": "Q1–Q6 are the six domain items, Q7 is an independent overall item explicitly excluded from Q1–Q6, and Q8 is open text with no numeric role. All eight items match the frozen R01 questionnaire text after the disclosed punctuation normalization (no Chinese enumeration commas or terminal punctuation), the 1–5 anchors and N/A exclusion are stated in the instrument, appendix form and dictionary, and the pooled-index rule does not absorb Q7."
    },
    {
      "id": "C04_denominators_dataset_and_register_locators",
      "result": "PASS",
      "locator": "§陸-一 各期樣本回收與有效母數彙總表；附錄三 36 列；替換清冊 response rows FACT-SYN-0141-SAT-TREND-R01-*-001…-012（docx_locator 附錄三第1列至第36列）；pointer rows FACT-SYN-0141-FRAME-2023/2024/2025、Q8-VIGNETTE、SOP-PARAMS、SUPPRESSION、ACT-01、ACT-02",
      "evidence": "15 invitations and 12 valid returns give 80.00% for each year; 45/36 gives 80.00% overall; Q1–Q6 valid answers are 72 per year and 216 in total, with Q7 counted separately. All 36 appendix rows were matched one-by-one against the frozen CSV (case IDs, years, cohorts, segment, Q1–Q7 scores, Q8 marker) and all 36 register locators 附錄三第1–36列 line up with the same order, with row 13 = 2024-001 and row 25 = 2025-001. Register row count is 44 (36 response + 8 pointer rows), consistent with the receipt."
    },
    {
      "id": "C05_independent_recalculation_of_aggregates",
      "result": "PASS",
      "locator": "§壹-一 2/3/4；§陸-二 逐題統計表；§柒-一 1–5",
      "evidence": "Recomputed from the 36 frozen rows: Q1–Q6 sums 2023 = 42/41/42/43/42/41 (pooled 251/72 = 3.4861), 2024 = 42/41/42/43/48/41 (257/72 = 3.5694), 2025 = 42/47/42/43/51/41 (266/72 = 3.6944); Q7 sums 43/47/51 = 3.5833/3.9167/4.2500. Deltas +0.0833, +0.1250, +0.2083 and Q7 +0.3333, +0.3333, +0.6667 are correct, as are Q5 +0.5000/+0.2500/+0.7500 and Q2 0.0000/+0.5000/+0.5000. Q6 is 3.4167 in all three periods and is the lowest item in 2025."
    },
    {
      "id": "C06_top2_counts_and_percentage_points",
      "result": "PASS",
      "locator": "§陸-三 Q7 Top-2 統計表與計算註；§捌 方案二 具體成效檢驗指標；附錄四-2 單題 Top-2 公式",
      "evidence": "Q7 counts 2023 5/7/0 → 7 = 58.33%; 2024 2/9/1 → 10 = 83.33%; 2025 1/7/4 → 11 = 91.67%; period changes +25.00 and +8.33 percentage points and the full-period +33.33 points (1–3 分 −4, 4 分 0, 5 分 +4) are correct. The note that (11/12−10/12)×100% = 8.33 while subtracting rounded 91.67%−83.33% would give 8.34 is correct. Q2 item Top-2 is 5/12 = 41.67%, 5/12 = 41.67%, 9/12 = 75.00% and Q5 Top-2 is 6/12, 8/12, 10/12, matching the frozen rows."
    },
    {
      "id": "C07_hypothetical_targets_and_strict_threshold",
      "result": "PASS",
      "locator": "§捌 方案一 具體成效檢驗指標；§捌 方案二 具體成效檢驗指標；附錄四-2 單題 Top-2 正面滿意率",
      "evidence": "Only baseline + 1/12 illustrative next-period targets remain: Q5 4.2500 + 1/12 = 4.3333 and Q2 3.9167 + 1/12 = 4.0000, both stated to be judged on unrounded values with the +1/12 rule generalized for other n. The strict rule is stated both in the proposal and the formula sheet: Top-2 success requires strictly more than 75.00%, so at n = 12 at least 10/12 = 83.33% is required and 9/12 = 75.00% fails.
No undefined 3.8000/3.7000 floors and no ambiguous 「目標 75%」 wording remain."
    },
    {
      "id": "C08_SAMPLE_REAL_and_authority_boundary",
      "result": "PASS",
      "locator": "報告基本資訊 表（本報告資料屬性宣告／真實資料狀態／外部核定狀態）；§壹-二；§參-四；§肆 開頭；§捌 當前狀態標註；§拾-一 步驟 5 與狀態框；附錄二/三；附錄五-1；結尾句",
      "evidence": "Every respondent, date, score, proposal and parameter is labelled SAMPLE/SYNTHETIC; all 36 rows carry SAMPLE_SYNTHETIC and the Q8 cells are marker text only, with the separate vignette explicitly excluded from the 36-row statistics. Proposals are marked SAMPLE_HYPOTHETICAL_NOT_ADOPTED and NOT_ADOPTED/NOT_EXECUTED, with no meeting decision, approval, signature, complaint record, real recovery rate or performance claim asserted. REAL = UNKNOWN/HOLD, Human formal acceptance = NOT_GRANTED, Official score = NOT_ASSIGNED, and the five-step flow states CURRENT ≠ REAL and that calculation passing does not reclassify data."
    },
    {
      "id": "C09_neighbor_separation_and_causality_block",
      "result": "PASS",
      "locator": "§貳-二 排除表；§柒-二 1–4；§捌 開頭段與各方案「對應期別轉折（回溯對照）」；§玖 規則 10/11；附錄五-1 文件/要求表",
      "evidence": "0139/I19-E29/index153 (licensing, employment), 0140/I19-E30/index154 (information-system uptake) and 0142/I19-E32/index156 (revenue) are excluded by construct and no cross-construct metric is used. All trend arithmetic is reported in 1–5 scale points with an explicit ban on percent-growth wording; the two sample trajectories are declared retrospective with no before/after ordering, and causal attribution is blocked absent a control design and verified intervention log."
    },
    {
      "id": "C10_prior_findings_M01_M04",
      "result": "PASS",
      "locator": "§捌 方案一「原擬附加之『無行政聯繫延誤之負面抱怨』條件仍標示為 UNKNOWN-sourced…」；§拾-一 標題與流程圖步驟 1–5 及狀態框；附錄四-2「方案二之 Q2 Top-2（門檻 >75.00%；n=12 至少 10/12）」；§捌 方案一/二「舊版所列分析下限已自本版撤除；本版不設分析下限」",
      "evidence": "The last occurrence of 「UNKNOWN-sourced」 in §玖 規則 13 is generic, but the same tag now appears at the live complaint condition with provenance scope (source, applicable period, responsible role, escalation condition) and the express statement that the label records a gap and is not source evidence; the five-step heading, flowchart and numbered prose agree and treat authorization review as step 5/CURRENT candidate gate; the formula sheet states the strict >75.00% threshold with the 10/12 minimum; and the retired 3.8000/3.7000 values no longer appear anywhere in the text, leaving baseline + 1/12 as the only illustrative targets. See prior_findings_disposition for item-by-item results."
    },
    {
      "id": "C11_register_hash_binding_scope",
      "result": "PASS",
      "locator": "替換清冊 source_manuscript_sha256 欄（全 44 列）＝15f8037adeb1cc4eaa105e8e21fca34901226c2573add42fe2e8650da4b4d6cb；R07-C1 source/math QA receipt manuscript_sha256 與 candidate_docx_sha256；附錄五-1 CSV SHA 列",
      "evidence": "All 44 register rows are bound to one and the same manuscript SHA, which equals the receipt's manuscript_sha256, and the receipt separately declares the reviewed candidate DOCX SHA 0922f737…; the appendix registration entry cites the frozen response CSV SHA 723259… correctly. The register is bound to the manuscript, not to the DOCX bytes, and the manuscript→DOCX derivation cannot be checked from extracted text; this is recorded as a limitation rather than a defect because the declared binding is internally consistent and the register locators verify against the supplied text."
    },
    {
      "id": "C12_version_identification_and_document_control",
      "result": "PARTIAL",
      "locator": "報告基本資訊 表「報告版本與合成事實識別碼」；封面「版本界線」段；附錄五-2 版本修訂歷史（R07-C1-SYN 列）",
      "evidence": "The revision-history table identifies the current candidate as R07-C1-SYN and describes the four C1 repairs, but the cover version-boundary paragraph and the basic-information version field still say R07 and describe only the R06→R07 scope. The three fields therefore do not agree on the current version identifier, which weakens self-contained exact-SHA traceability even though the receipt and history are consistent. See minor finding R07-C1-m01."
    }
  ],
  "prior_findings_disposition": {
    "M01_ascii_unknown_sourced_complaint_condition": "RESOLVED — §捌 方案一 具體成效檢驗指標 now carries the ASCII 「UNKNOWN-sourced」 tag directly on the 「無行政聯繫延誤之負面抱怨」 condition, with provenance scope (原始資料來源、適用期間、責任角色與升級條件) and the explicit statement 「此標籤僅記錄缺口、不構成來源證據」. Residual caveat: the plain-text extraction cannot prove the hyphen's Unicode codepoint (U+002D vs U+2011), so searchability is established only as rendered.",
    "M02_five_step_replacement_flow": "RESOLVED — §拾-一 is titled 「真實資料替換五步檢核流程（SAMPLE）」, the flowchart shows boxes 步驟 1–5 with step 5 「授權角色審查（CURRENT 晉級關卡）」 and terminal state 「CURRENT（候選）」, and numbered prose items 1–5 match (roster, anonymization, register, deterministic verification, authorization review and candidate control). No four-step wording remains.",
    "M03_formula_sheet_strict_threshold": "RESOLVED — 附錄四-2 now reads 「方案二之 Q2 Top-2（門檻 >75.00%；n=12 至少 10/12）」 and the proposal repeats that 9/12 = 75.00% does not exceed the threshold; the ambiguous 「目標 75%」 wording is gone.",
    "M04_retired_analysis_floors": "RESOLVED — 3.8000 and 3.7000 no longer appear anywhere in the candidate text; both proposals state 「舊版所列分析下限已自本版撤除；本版不設分析下限，也不以分析下限篩除資料」, and the only illustrative next-period targets are 4.2500 + 1/12 = 4.3333 and 3.9167 + 1/12 = 4.0000, with the strict Top-2 condition kept as the separately authorized success rule."
  },
  "reviewer_scope": "SEMANTIC_TEXT_ONLY",
  "actual_model_identity": "UNKNOWN",
  "tool_use_events": [],
  "limitations": [
    "No DOCX binary, OOXML structure, Word native render, page image, chart pixel or PDF visual layer was inspected; the packet supplies extracted text only, so the referenced visual receipt scope metadata and all-page layout were not verified.",
    "Table text appears after the paragraph flow in the extraction, so section-to-table mapping was inferred from table content and register locators; column widths, merged cells, chart axis rendering and font floors were not assessable.",
    "The replacement register is bound to manuscript SHA 15f8037adeb1cc4eaa105e8e21fca34901226c2573add42fe2e8650da4b4d6cb, while the candidate DOCX SHA 0922f737… is declared only in the source/math QA receipt; the manuscript→DOCX derivation could not be independently verified in this text-only scope, and receipt metadata was not treated as semantic proof.",
    "The Unicode codepoint of the hyphen in 「UNKNOWN-sourced」 could not be confirmed from plain extracted text; only the visible ASCII-style glyph, its placement at the complaint condition, its provenance scope and its not-evidence statement were assessed.",
    "The source/math QA receipt was used only as an index for arithmetic that was independently recomputed from the 36 frozen rows; its PASS status and semantic_repair_checks flags were not inherited.",
    "The official page-9 source could be reviewed only through the supplied extracted excerpt, not the PDF visual page; the source-PDF hash, page-image hash and visual checkbox evidence were not re-verified.",
    "Requested route opencode/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free; no native provider/model metadata was supplied, so the actual serving model remains UNKNOWN and no model-identity claim is made.",
    "No external assumptions, real evidence, association approvals, signatures, actual survey results or formal acceptance were introduced or inferred."
  ],
  "formal_acceptance": "NOT_GRANTED",
  "real_data_status": "UNKNOWN/HOLD",
  "official_score": "NOT_ASSIGNED"
}
